messages:
emily-support: Hey team — BrightAtlas flagged a surprise jump on their Feb invoice vs our dashboard, looks like ~3x token metering for a subset of calls. They sent a few example request IDs: req_6a1f8c, req_6a1f8c, req_6a1f8c (same id repeated). Customer says dashboard shows one call, invoice shows three. Can eng / infra confirm if retries or replays were billed multiple times?

paul-brightatlas: fwiw customer timeline — they saw latency spikes and some 504s around 2026-02-11T14:22Z, then a big invoice line for that day. We think their SDK retried but only one of the attempts should be metered.

raj-eng: looking. Quick note: gateway logs show outbound retries for 502/504 on POST /v1/generate during that window. Gateway was doing automatic retries without honoring idempotency keys for that path. Snippet from proxy logs (redacted):
```
[2026-02-11T14:22:03Z] proxy: forward req_id=req_6a1f8c -> upstream; got 504
[2026-02-11T14:22:04Z] proxy: retrying req_id=req_6a1f8c (attempt=2)
[2026-02-11T14:22:05Z] proxy: retrying req_id=req_6a1f8c (attempt=3)
[2026-02-11T14:22:06Z] proxy: upstream ok, responded 200
```

raj-eng: Metering events however are emitted per successful upstream response and also on retry completion in some older path (legacy emit on every client completion). So if gateway retried and each attempt completed enough to trigger metering, billing could show 3 events for same request.

maria-billing: Confirmed — billing ledger entries for the time window show three separate meter events with the same request_id but different event_id. Our invoice generator treats ledger rows as billable unless deduped by idempotency_key. The dashboard view dedupes using idempotency_key when present; but the ledger ingestion sometimes lacked that header because the proxy drop happened earlier.

oliver-sre: Repro notes: emulate a backend 504 + proxy retry. On current proxy config we have:
```
retry_policy: {
  status_codes: [502, 503, 504]
  retry_on_idempotent: true
  forward_idempotency_header: false  # OOPS - default false for legacy proxies
}
```
If the client does not set Idempotency-Key, proxy retries are unsafe. And we weren't forwarding the header to metering service, so dedupe keys were missing in ledger rows.

emily-support: So root cause appears to be a combination: (1) proxy retries on 5xx, (2) proxy not forwarding idempotency header to metering, (3) ledger ingest path didn't dedupe when idempotency_key is absent. We need a short-term mitigation + long-term fix.

raj-eng: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) turn off automatic retries for POST /v1/generate in the gateway for 24h in affected regions; 2) patch gateway to forward `Idempotency-Key` header to metering service; 3) patch metering to dedupe based on request_id if idempotency_key missing for a short backfill window. I'll open a PR for (2) and (3) now.

maria-billing: For customer impact: if we dedupe by request_id we can compress the three ledger rows into one and issue credits for the overcharged amount. Need list of affected accounts and an estimated dollar delta. Can infra produce a queryable list?

raj-eng: running a query now against ingress logs -> correlating proxy request_id to ledger_event (by request_id). Rough psuedo-sql I ran:
```
SELECT request_id, count(*) AS events, sum(tokens) AS billed_tokens
FROM ledger_events
WHERE request_time BETWEEN '2026-02-11T14:20:00Z' AND '2026-02-11T14:30:00Z'
AND request_id LIKE 'req_%'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING events > 1
ORDER BY billed_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Result: ~42 unique request_ids with events=3 and ~12 accounts hit, BrightAtlas among top 3.

maria-billing: Thanks. Can we do a backfill for the Feb invoice run? If we can dedupe ledger rows and compute a credit, we can issue an adjustment. Also set a temporary grace credit policy for customers who hit >1.5x discrepancy.

oliver-sre: I'll also enable extra tracing for the metering path (add request_id, idempotency_key, ingress-attempt headers) and turn on a sampling flag for requests that later show multiple ledger rows so we can inspect payloads.

gateway-bot: Deploy scheduled: gateway config change (disable retries for POST /v1/generate) planned to regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. ETA 30m.

raj-eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/421 — forwards Idempotency-Key -> metering and makes the header mandatory for forwarding. Also adding a small dedupe filter on emit. Will roll patch to canary and monitor.

emily-support: Maria, please draft a customer note for BrightAtlas offering a credit while we backfill. Include explanation: transient retries caused duplicate ledger rows; we are fixing gateway + metering and will issue a retroactive credit. Keep wording non-technical.

maria-billing: Will do. Also need estimated credit amount ASAP — I have the per-token rate for BrightAtlas plan, running calc now.

paul-brightatlas: Appreciate the quick triage. Please keep us posted and confirm when the credit posts.

raj-eng: Canary shows reduced duplicate ledger rows after patch on canary: before patch 3/3 duplicates, after patch sampled 1/60 duplicates. Rolling to more regions.

oliver-sre: Followups: (A) we'll add a safety dedupe in billing job for next invoice run that treats repeated request_id as a single billable event for a 72-hour backfill window; (B) add a metric alert for ratio(invoice_tokens / dashboard_tokens) > 1.2 for any customer for 24h.

maria-billing: Sounds good. I'll prepare the credits list and the customer comms.

emily-support: Thanks everyone. Action items recap: raj -> gateway forward header + disable retries (in flight); oliver -> tracing + dedupe flag + alert; maria -> credits + comms; emily -> coordinate with BrightAtlas.

raj-eng: ETA: gateway full rollout + metering patch -> 3 hours; backfill job -> ops window tomorrow morning.

maria-billing: Noted. I'll queue the credit adjustments post-backfill and send a summary to accounting.

emily-support: closing loop once credits issued. :bow:
